name: Fonts and Dev Files
author: Wasi Master
description: Shows fonts, certificates, torrents and property lists in the keyboard's file manager. A TrueType or OpenType font is drawn in sample text with its name, designer, licence, glyph count and variable axes. A certificate shows who it was issued to and by, when it expires, its other names and its fingerprints. A .torrent lists its files, size, trackers and info hash, and an Apple .plist (text or binary) opens as folding sections.
